title: Cloud Engineer I
description:
Job Summary The Cloud Engineer I is responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing cloud infrastructure and services to support the company s global software solutions. This role leverages advanced technical expertise and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex cloud engineering challenges. The position plays a key role in shaping cloud practices and driving technical excellence across teams and projects. Responsibilities Advanced knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps Knowledge of security best practices in cloud environments (e.g., IAM, encryption, key management) Ability to analyze complex systems and troubleshoot distributed applications. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Understanding cost management and optimization strategies in cloud environments. Perform all other duties and activities as required Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values: Mission: To empower insurers to reimagine the future of insurance Education and Work Experience Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, or DevOps roles. Preferred Qualifications Master s degree in a related field Professional certifications such as Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02), or Google Cloud Digital Leader Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment. Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, and Behaviors Experience with Microsoft Azure components (compute, storage, networking basics, Key Vault, subnets, firewalls, load balancers, Cosmos DB etc.) Experience with deployment/release tooling - Octopus Deploy or similar Solid working knowledge with the ability to write and run SQL queries for troubleshooting and data validation (e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or similar) Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Demonstrated ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams Understanding cost management and optimization strategies in cloud environments Commitment to continuous learning and professional development Other Requirements The standard working hours for this role are 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST (UK shift). Candidates will also be required to participate in a rotational US shift schedule (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST) to support business and operational requirements. An applicable shift allowance will be provided for hours worked during the US shift in accordance with company policy. Core Competencies Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing-treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds. Location and Ways of Working Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities. At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs. The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
